subject: Portal transition: invoice payload requirements, PO ack timing, and email fallback
messages:
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@brightedge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Transition to Redwood portal - invoice format questions

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the onboarding kick-off earlier this morning. BrightEdge is ready to start sending invoices into Redwood's new vendor portal but we wanted to confirm a few items around the payload so we can update our ERP export. I attached a small sample CSV (sample-invoice.csv).

Quick questions: 
- Do you require the PO number in the email subject during the transition, or is the PO mapped solely in the payload (po_number column)?
- How should we indicate partial shipments or split line shipments (we currently send shipment_line_id per line). Is that ok?
- We have invoices that include multiple tax rates on different rows (federal/state county tax). Do you accept a tax_code per line or should taxes be aggregated into separate lines?
- Credit memos: should those be created as stand-alone invoices with invoice_type=CM and reference the original invoice in invoice_ref?
- During the portal migration window can we continue to email invoices to accounts-payable@brightedge.com (our current fallback) for 2 weeks while we QA the portal exports? If yes, any special subject token we should include so they get picked up by your migration process?
- Any SFTP/EDIFACT fallback we should plan for if the portal onboarding is delayed?

Appreciate a short example row and the recommended column set so we can adapt our extract.

Regards,
Tom Hargreaves
Finance Ops Lead
BrightEdge Solutions
Tom.H@brightedge.com

Hi Tom — great to hear you’re ready. Below are the concise requirements and a sample row you can drop into your ERP export. I’ve attached the PO for reference (PO-12345.pdf).

High-level transition policy
- Transition window: 2026-09-19 through 2026-10-19. During that period we will accept invoices via portal OR email. After 2026-10-19 portal-only.
- Email fallback: include the token TRANSITION in the subject for any invoices you email during the window (e.g., "INV 20260919 - PO12345 TRANSITION"). That flags them for expedited ingestion.
- PO ack: our system posts a PO_ACK within 24 hours of receiving the PO mapping request; if you do not see PO_ACK within 24 hours please escalate to vendor-onboard@redwood.com.

Required CSV columns (recommended order):
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (string)
- shipment_line_id (string) — use for partial/split shipments
- line_description (string)
- quantity (decimal)
- unit_price (decimal)
- tax_code (string) — supports per-line tax rate mapping
- tax_amount (decimal)
- currency (ISO)
- invoice_type (INV|CM)
- invoice_ref (string) — for credit memos reference original invoice number

Sample CSV row (one-line):
INV-20260918,2026-09-18,PO-12345,SHIP-001,Cloud GPU hours,12,18.50,STATE-001,22.20,USD,INV,

Notes on taxes and credit memos
- You may include multiple tax codes by placing separate rows per tax element on the same invoice with the same invoice_number and a clear tax_code. Our ingestion will sum tax_amount per invoice.
- Credit memos: set invoice_type=CM and add invoice_ref=<original_invoice_number>. We also accept a CM- prefix but invoice_type is required.

SFTP fallback
- We do support SFTP ingest for high-volume partners; that requires a short onboarding (SSH key exchange) and a nightly pickup window. If you think you need this, we can provision a temporary folder while you test portal exports.

Action items for BrightEdge
1) Send back one adapted CSV with 3 sample rows including a partial shipment row and a credit memo row.
2) Use subject token TRANSITION for any emailed invoices in the next 30 days.

I'll loop in Marissa to update the portal template to accept shipment_line_id and invoice_ref as explicit fields.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.f@redwood.com

Thanks Naomi — that is very clear and helpful. Two quick clarifications before we send the sample CSV: 
1) For PO_ACK: is 24 hours calendar hours or business hours? We operate in GMT and want to set internal alerts appropriately.
2) For credit memos: do you require a separate credit memo_number format (we usually prefix CM-) or is invoice_type=CM sufficient?

Also, we may need SFTP for the first two weeks while our ERP vendor updates the export. Can you open the temporary SFTP provisioning ticket and share contact steps?

Tom

Marissa: please ensure the portal template supports shipment_line_id (string), invoice_ref (string) and per-line tax_code. Also add a visible guidance note that credit memos require invoice_type=CM and invoice_ref. If you can push the template update today we can tell them to start testing.

Karthik: confirm we are ok to accept emailed invoices with subject token TRANSITION during 2026-09-19 through 2026-10-19 and confirm SLA on PO_ACK (24 calendar hours or 24 business hours). If we choose business hours we need to communicate that explicitly — vendor is in GMT. Also please open a temporary SFTP provisioning ticket (PROC-412) and set owner.
